newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sahid Jaya to propose rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Sahid Jaya to propose rights issue.

text.p: Indonesian hotel operator PT Sahid Jaya said on Wednesday it proposed a rights issue to finance expansion plans.
"We have submitted the letter to Bapepam (Stock Exchange Supervisory Agency) today that we are planning to propose a rights issue," Sahid Jaya corporate secretary Ari B. Wibisono told Reuters.
Wibisono said the proceeds would be used to finance expansion plans, including acquiring some affiliated companies, and also to strengthen its core business in hotel industry.
He declined to give details on the ratio of the rights issue and estimated proceeds.
Wibisono said the plan was subject to shareholders' approval at a meeting scheduled for the first week of September.
At 0830 GMT, the share price of Sahid Jaya was up 15.15 percent, or 375 rupiah, to 2,850 rupiah on active trading of 2.6 million shares.
